The '''''Sweet Time''''' was a modified [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] space yacht used by a [[Jedi Coalition]] strike team&mdash;composed of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ben Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]&mdash;as their base of operations during a mission to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After Skywalker was captured by [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Tahiri Veila]] and the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]], the rest of the strike team flew the ''Sweet Time'' into a Jedi Coalition rendezvous point to report Ben's capture to his father, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="invincible" />
